nodes.description: A 900x700 placeholder SVG standing in for a redacted case-study exploration image. It shows a dark charcoal (#3d3d3b) background with a faint 4x3 grid overlay (light gray lines at 25% opacity), and text reading 'Confidential — Exploration A' in a bold sans-serif headline, with a monospace caption below reading 'REJECTED · 900×700'. The SVG's aria-label also reads 'Confidential — Exploration A'. It functions as a redacted/withheld image marker rather than showing actual design content, likely used because the real Equinox EMR exploration artwork is under NDA.
